title: One manager for work, income, body and mind: what Life Manager Cloud actually runs

# One manager for work, income, body and mind: what Life Manager Cloud actually runs

Most people do not have one problem. They have five: work that stalls, money that needs attention, everyday responsibilities that pile up, a body that needs care, and a mind that will not quiet down. Managing those with five separate tools is itself a sixth job.

Life Manager is one proactive manager for all five. It chooses useful priorities, carries work forward, and verifies outcomes, without waiting for a daily prompt.

## What it is, in one paragraph

Life Manager is one manager for your work, income, body, and mind. It takes initiative: it picks the next useful priority, moves the work ahead, and checks the result. You do not have to prompt it every day, and you do not have to hold five separate systems in your head.

## Two ways to run the same manager

- **Local:** run the open-source core on your own computer.
- **Cloud:** use Life Manager Cloud, hosted on a dedicated Maritime VM, running continuously and reporting verified progress to your sign-in email.

Local and Cloud are two hosting modes of the same manager, not two different products.

## What Life Manager Cloud costs

Life Manager Cloud is $29/month after a 7-day free trial.

## What sign-up needs

Google sign-in verifies identity only. Calendar access, Gmail inbox access, a task prompt, goals, budget, or payout details are not required at sign-up.

## How the earning work moves: five steps, verified, not promised

Life Manager's earning workflow is called MoneyPrinter, and it runs in five steps:

1. Find an opportunity.
2. Create or apply.
3. Distribute.
4. Verify the result.
5. Improve from what the result actually showed.

Its first earning workflow uses Capafy. Capafy requires Publisher Certification and publisher confirmation before each Agent version can go live. The complete Cloud-to-Capafy path is still being verified, and earnings are not guaranteed. That limit matters: this is a manager that keeps income-generating work moving and checks its own results, not a promise of income.

## Who this is for

This is for people who want one manager to keep work, money, everyday responsibilities, body, and mind moving, instead of managing five separate tools. It is not for people who want a guaranteed income, a set-and-forget money machine, or a tool that decides everything without verification.

## Try the manager, not the promise

If the idea of one manager instead of five tools sounds useful, start from the product page, where the price, the trial, and the sign-up requirements are stated plainly:

- Life Manager: https://aniccaai.com/lm

One manager. Five areas. Verified results, one step at a time.
